title: Understanding Model Variance
text: Model variance refers to how much the predictions of a model will change if we use a different training dataset. Consider how the complexity of the model might affect this variance.

title: Impact of Training Set Size
text: Think about how increasing or decreasing the size of the training set might influence the model's ability to generalize and how it might affect the variance.

title: Training Set Size and Variance
text: Does a larger training set generally increase or decrease model variance?
